msi.Downgrade: Nooc ka cusub oo FuzeVPN ah ayaa durba rakiban.
msi.WindowsX64: Rakibahani wuxuu u baahan yahay Windows {Architecture}. Dooro xirmada ku habboon kombiyuutarkaaga.
msi.Rollback: Dib u celinta Windows Installer waa in la hawlgeliyaa si FuzeVPN si ammaan ah loo rakibo ama looga saaro.
msi.ServiceDescription: Wuxuu maamulaa tunnel-yada FuzeVPN WireGuard iyo OpenVPN oo keliya.
native.1: FuzeVPN waa rakiban yahay, balse adeeggiisu ma xaqiijin inuu dib u bilaabmay. Mar kale wad rakibidda si aad u hagaajiso app-ka.
native.2: Nooca ama qaab-dhismeedka Windows lama xaqiijin karo. Eeg diiwaanka rakibidda.
native.3: FuzeVPN wuxuu u baahan yahay Windows 10 ama Windows 11.
native.4: Rakibahani wuxuu u baahan yahay Windows {Architecture}. Dooro xirmada ku habboon kombiyuutarkaaga.
native.5: Dib u celinta Windows Installer waa in la hawlgeliyaa ka hor hawl kasta oo dayactirka FuzeVPN ah.
native.6: Dooro gal maxalli ah oo leh waddo dhammaystiran si aad u rakibto FuzeVPN.
native.7: Nooc ka cusub ayaa durba rakiban, ama noociisa lama xaqiijin karo.
native.9: Hubinta nooca ama galka way fashilantay.
native.10: VPN-ku ma xaqiijin inuu istaagay. Rakibidda waa la hakiyay iyada oo aan faylasha la beddelin.
native.11: Xir FuzeVPN iyo kaaliyihiisa cusboonaysiinta, dabadeed mar kale wad rakibidda. Wax hawl ah si khasab ah looma joojin.
native.12: VPN-ka si ammaan ah looma joojin karo.
native.13: Dayactirka lama dhammaystiri karo. Mar kale wad rakibidda si aad u hagaajiso FuzeVPN.
native.14: Dib u celintu waxay sii haysaa xannibaadda shabakadda ee dayactirka; mar kale wad rakibidda si aad u hagaajiso.
theme.SuccessOpenApp: Fur FuzeVPN adigoo ka furaya menu-ga Start. Dookhyadaada gaarka ah waa la ilaaliyay.
